# Code Review Prompts

PR and review behavior: honest replies, intact threads, real fixes, approvals that mean something.

**24 prompts.** Install the whole category bundle:

```
Please fetch https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bentheautomator/free_ai_prompts_that_dont_suck/main/install/code-review.md and append its contents to my project instructions file.
```

| Prompt | Severity | What It Solves | Install |
|--------|----------|----------------|---------|
| [Address Every Point, Not Just the Easy Ones](address-every-point-not-just-the-easy-ones.md) | high | Stops partial fixes presented as full responses to multi-point review comments | [install](../../install/address-every-point-not-just-the-easy-ones.md) |
| [Discuss Requested Changes You Disagree With](discuss-requested-changes-you-disagree-with.md) | high | Stops silently skipping requested changes the assistant disagrees with | [install](../../install/discuss-requested-changes-you-disagree-with.md) |
| [Don't Merge Past Outstanding Change Requests](dont-merge-past-outstanding-change-requests.md) | high | Stops merging while another reviewer's change request still stands | [install](../../install/dont-merge-past-outstanding-change-requests.md) |
| [Don't Reply "Fixed" Without Pushing the Fix](dont-reply-fixed-without-pushing-code.md) | high | Stops review replies claiming fixes that exist nowhere on the branch | [install](../../install/dont-reply-fixed-without-pushing-code.md) |
| [Fix the Issue, Don't Silence the Signal](fix-the-issue-dont-silence-the-signal.md) | high | Stops review comments being closed by muting whatever exposed the problem | [install](../../install/fix-the-issue-dont-silence-the-signal.md) |
| [No Unrelated Changes After Approval](no-unrelated-changes-after-approval.md) | high | Stops new, unreviewed changes from riding an existing approval into main | [install](../../install/no-unrelated-changes-after-approval.md) |
| [Read the Surrounding Code, Not Just the Diff](read-surrounding-code-not-just-the-diff.md) | high | Stops reviews that judge changed lines without reading what surrounds them | [install](../../install/read-surrounding-code-not-just-the-diff.md) |
| [Resolve Only the Threads You Actually Fixed](resolve-only-threads-you-fixed.md) | high | Stops review threads being resolved while the underlying issue is untouched | [install](../../install/resolve-only-threads-you-fixed.md) |
| [Split Oversized PRs Into Reviewable Units](split-oversized-prs-for-review.md) | high | Stops 4,000-line single PRs that nobody can meaningfully review | [install](../../install/split-oversized-prs-for-review.md) |
| [Verify Assumptions Before Approving](verify-assumptions-before-approving.md) | high | Stops approvals built on 'presumably the tests cover this' style assumptions | [install](../../install/verify-assumptions-before-approving.md) |
| [Answer "Why" Questions Instead of Changing the Code](answer-why-questions-instead-of-changing-code.md) | medium | Stops 'why did you do X' being answered by deleting X instead of explaining it | [install](../../install/answer-why-questions-instead-of-changing-code.md) |
| [Check Fit Before Applying a Fix Everywhere](check-fit-before-applying-a-fix-everywhere.md) | medium | Stops one review comment's fix from being pattern-matched across the codebase | [install](../../install/check-fit-before-applying-a-fix-everywhere.md) |
| [Don't Force-Push Over an Active Review](dont-force-push-over-active-reviews.md) | medium | Stops history rewrites that orphan a reviewer's in-progress line comments | [install](../../install/dont-force-push-over-active-reviews.md) |
| [Don't Invent Standards When Reviewing](dont-invent-standards-when-reviewing.md) | medium | Stops review comments citing conventions the project never actually adopted | [install](../../install/dont-invent-standards-when-reviewing.md) |
| [Don't Mark a Draft Ready With Known Issues](dont-mark-drafts-ready-with-known-issues.md) | medium | Stops draft PRs being flipped to ready while known problems sit unfixed | [install](../../install/dont-mark-drafts-ready-with-known-issues.md) |
| [Fix Blockers Before Nitpicks](fix-blockers-before-nitpicks.md) | medium | Stops review responses that polish nitpicks while blockers sit untouched | [install](../../install/fix-blockers-before-nitpicks.md) |
| [Give Reasons, Not Verdicts, When Reviewing](give-reasons-not-verdicts-when-reviewing.md) | medium | Stops review comments that pronounce judgment without showing the failure | [install](../../install/give-reasons-not-verdicts-when-reviewing.md) |
| [Hold PR Scope Steady During Review](hold-pr-scope-steady-during-review.md) | medium | Stops PRs from growing new features and refactors mid-review | [install](../../install/hold-pr-scope-steady-during-review.md) |
| [Keep the PR Description Synced With Revisions](keep-pr-descriptions-synced-with-revisions.md) | medium | Stops PR descriptions from describing code the PR no longer contains | [install](../../install/keep-pr-descriptions-synced-with-revisions.md) |
| [Label Comments Blocking or Nit When Reviewing](label-blocking-vs-nit-when-reviewing.md) | medium | Stops reviews where authors can't tell which comments actually gate merge | [install](../../install/label-blocking-vs-nit-when-reviewing.md) |
| [Say So When You Implement a Suggestion Differently](say-so-when-you-implement-suggestions-differently.md) | medium | Stops silent substitutions when a reviewer's suggestion gets a different fix | [install](../../install/say-so-when-you-implement-suggestions-differently.md) |
| [Summarize What Changed When Re-Requesting Review](summarize-changes-when-re-requesting-review.md) | medium | Stops silent re-review requests that make reviewers re-derive what changed | [install](../../install/summarize-changes-when-re-requesting-review.md) |
| [Weigh Review Comments Before Pushing Back](weigh-review-comments-before-pushing-back.md) | medium | Stops reflexive point-by-point rebuttals of every review comment received | [install](../../install/weigh-review-comments-before-pushing-back.md) |
